command: import{readFileSync,statSync}from'node:fs';import{spawnSync}from'node:child_process';import{credentials}from'./packages/db/src/config.ts';for(const file of ['/proc/net/tcp','/proc/net/tcp6'])for(const row of readFileSync(file,'utf8').trim().split('\n').slice(1)){const p=row.trim().split(/\s+/),port=parseInt(p[1].split(':')[1],16);if(p[3]==='0A'&&[5173,3001,3002].includes(port))throw new Error('Foundation listener remains on'+port);}for(const file of ['.env.local','.local/database.json']){if((statSync(file).mode&0o777)!==0o600||spawnSync('git',['check-ignore','-q',file]).status!==0)throw new Error('Private file protection failed');}const secrets=[process.env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD,...Object.values(credentials().passwords).flatMap(Object.values)].filter(Boolean);const tracked=spawnSync('git',['ls-files','-z'],{encoding:'utf8'}).stdout.split('\0').filter(Boolean);for(const file of tracked){if(file==='.env.local'||file.startsWith('.local/'))throw new Error('Tracked private file');const bytes=readFileSync(file,'utf8');if(secrets.some(value=>bytes.includes(value)))throw new Error('Known private credential in tracked bytes');}for(const file of ['docs/vision/requirements.csv','docs/vision/original_action_items.md','docs/vision/decision_register.csv','docs/vision/additional_scope.csv','docs/vision/dependencies.json','docs/vision/source_register.json','docs/vision/rules_certification_template.csv','docs/vision/container-manifests.json','SHA256SUMS.txt','VALIDATION_RESULTS.json']){const prior=spawnSync('git',['show','82e22733ebe41c01e373d409eac34e09345fbc1b:'+file]);if(prior.status!==0||!readFileSync(file).equals(prior.stdout))throw new Error('Original scope/provenance changed: '+file);}console.log('PASS actual5173/3001/3002 free, private600/ignored, staged known-secret scan and original scope/archive byte preservation');
